items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-12-09
items.q: he was a half cousin to my mother in any family

ctx.x: Joe Snaya. Uh, he was a state jungle player. He died some years ago, but, uh, he was a half cousin to my mother in any family. He's older people. And he, he, he left for North, uh, North. And how I saw him, uh, did a while in the U for the first time.

Um, he, alright, now, you just mentioned something else which I wanted to ask you about, is, this business about, um, going up north, leaving the city, going to Chicago and that thing. Did you ever think of that or did you ever feel like doing that? No, I never did.
